title: Dolphins Key West

services.name: Dolphins Key West
services.desc: This is a unique opportunity to see dolphins in their natural habitat and doesn't come around often. You can see them play together and then snorkel over brilliantly colored reef gardens within the shallow waters of this gorgeous marine wildlife sanctuary. You won't want to miss this chance to have a personal, up close experience with dolphins in the turquoise wonderland of Key West! This tour goes out on a 42-foot catamaran vessel designed for comfort, luxury, and speed. You will be greeted by a friendly crew and taken to the famous Dolphin Playground. Make sure you have your camera ready to get that perfect shot! After admiring the wild dolphins you will be able to experience a Key West

services.name: Dolphin Watch & Snorkel
services.desc: Our Dolphin Watch & Snorkel combo goes out on a larger 42-foot powered catamaran vessel that was custom designed for comfort, luxury, and speed. This is one of the best and most luxurious ways to experience the beautiful Key West back country where hundreds of our native dolphins make their home. Dolphins are a common site in Key West, but these dolphin tours take you out to the areas that are most highly populated by these charming and friendly marine mammals! It is not uncommon to spot over 20 dolphins on these Key West dolphin tours! When you climb on board our Dolphin Watch & Snorkel Combo package, you will be greeted by a friendly crew who is dedicated to making you have the best time

blurb: You'll be thrilled when these amazing, smiling creatures swim right up to the boat to look you right in the eye. This eco-tour includes the dolphin adventure, a tour of the local waters full of fascinating information about the wildlife you'll see, and a snorkel adventure over a colorful reef teeming with tropical fish.
